Script limitation, new this cycle: --benefit-track applies one rate to the WHOLE profit. A real benefit-track company usually has mixed qualifying and non-qualifying income and therefore a blended corporate rate. The script prints a warning line and Step 1b rule 1 states the limit, but a blended-rate input (share of income that is qualifying) would be the honest model. Consider next cycle.

The evidence file already carried the correct 16th claim against the SALARY regulations while the body still said 15th, so the two had silently diverged.
